title: humulus lupulus var. cordifolius
intro: Humulus lupulus var. cordifolius, commonly known as Heartleaf Hop, is a variety of the hop plant that is native to China and is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Heartleaf Hop include its potential to treat anxiety and insomnia, as well as its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Heartleaf Hop are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help to calm the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of Heartleaf Hop include flavonoids, saponins, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
